**Which system / game?**
e.g. BBC Micro — Elite (or "the DOS prompt itself")

**What happened?**
What you did, what you expected, what you got instead.

**The URL from the address bar**
Paste the full URL of the page where it went wrong (it identifies the exact
bundle and game).

**Browser + OS**
e.g. Firefox 141 on Linux, Safari on iPadOS.

**Anything in the console?** (optional)
F12 → Console — paste any red errors.
